zh.title: 長榮航空運送雄性斑哥條紋羚抵臺協助繁殖
zh.summary: 長榮航空運送雄性斑哥條紋羚抵臺，臺北動物園盼協助繁殖
body: 長榮航空運送雄性斑哥條紋羚Harris來臺。Harris於美國時間10月26日搭乘貨機自達拉斯機場起飛，並於臺灣時間27日晚間10時26分抵達桃園國際機場（TPE）。長榮航空表示，航程約18個小時，休士頓動物園副園長及保衛員也隨行照料。
臺北市立動物園表示，園內斑哥條紋羚族羣只剩5隻母羚，盼這隻雄性個體作為種源，協助繁殖並讓族羣更穩定。動物園預計在Harris通過一個月檢疫後對外展示。

en.title: EVA Air transports male bongo antelope to Taiwan for breeding
en.summary: EVA Air brings a male bongo antelope to Taiwan to support Taipei Zoo breeding.
body: EVA Air transported a male bongo antelope named Harris to Taiwan. Harris departed Dallas Airport aboard a cargo aircraft on Oct. 26 U.S. time and arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) at 10:26 p.m. Taiwan time on Oct. 27. EVA Air said the flight took about 18 hours, with the Houston Zoo's deputy director and an animal-care staff member accompanying and caring for him.

Taipei City Zoo said its bongo population consists of five females and that it hopes Harris will serve as breeding stock to help produce offspring and stabilize the group. The zoo expects to put him on public display after he passes a month of quarantine.

zh.title: Electra EL2 曼哈頓直升機停機坪固定翼起降示範
zh.summary: EL2 於 10/26 在曼哈頓直升機坪完成固定翼起降；展示超短跑道技術
body: Electra 於 2026 年 10 月 26 日駕駛其混合動力 EL2 Goldfinch 示範機，降落並起飛於紐約下城的 Downtown Skyport 直升機停機坪，這是該公司宣稱的首次固定翼飛機在無垂直起降能力下使用直升機坪。
Electra 執行長 Marc Allen 指出：「今天我們在曼哈頓市中心創造航空史，讓固定翼飛機降落在直升機坪，且不需要新建跑道。」
EL2 採用 blown lift（吹氣升力）技術，利用電動螺旋槳將氣流推過機翼與大襟翼，使飛機在極低速度下即可產生足夠升力，實現超短地面滑跑。
公司規劃的九座 EL9 目標起降地面滑跑距離為 150 英尺（約 46 公尺），並已於 2026 年 7 月獲得美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）確認認證基礎。
Electra 表示已獲得超過 2,200 份來自 60 多家商業客戶的意向書，支持 EL9 計畫。

en.title: Electra EL2 completes fixed‑wing landing and take‑off at Manhattan heliport, demonstrating ultra‑short take‑off capability
en.summary: Electra EL2 lands and takes off at Manhattan heliport; demonstrates blown‑lift ultra‑short take‑off tech
body: On 26 October 2026 Electra flew its hybrid‑electric EL2 Goldfinch demonstrator into Downtown Skyport, a waterfront heliport in Lower Manhattan, and performed a landing and take‑off, which the company says is the first fixed‑wing operation at the site without vertical‑takeoff capability.

Electra CEO Marc Allen said: “Today we made aviation history in downtown Manhattan by landing a fixed‑wing aircraft on a heliport. What’s even more interesting is that we didn’t need to build a new runway to do it.”

The EL2 uses blown‑lift technology: electrically driven propellers push air over the wings and large flaps, increasing lift at speeds far lower than conventional aircraft and allowing a very short ground roll.

Electra’s planned nine‑passenger EL9 targets a take‑off and landing ground roll of 150 feet (about 46 m). In July 2026 the FAA established the EL9’s certification basis, setting the regulatory framework for the programme.
The company reports more than 2,200 letters of intent from over 60 commercial customers for the EL9.

zh.title: 大西洋航空增購兩架A320neo 邁向全機隊換裝
zh.summary: 大西洋航空簽訂兩架A320neo訂單；目標2030年全機隊換裝
body: 大西洋航空於2026年10月27日與空中巴士簽署確定訂單，增購兩架A320neo客機，進一步推動其全機隊換裝計畫。
董事長尼爾斯·莫騰森表示：「我們的目標是於不久的將來實現純A320neo機隊，這項協議邁出關鍵一步。」此目標預計於2030年達成。
目前該航司自法羅羣島唯一的機場——瓦格機場（VSE）營運兩架A320-200與兩架A320neo，新訂單使其A320neo訂單總數達四架。
此項長期投資規模高達丹麥克朗20億元（約2.98億美元），兩架新訂購的A320neo預計於下個十年初交付。
空中巴士商務客機銷售執行副總裁班諾瓦·德·聖埃克絲佩裏指出，新增訂單將強化區域連通性，並持續支持法羅社區的高效聯繫。

en.title: Atlantic Airways signs firm order for two A320neo jets to advance all‑neo fleet goal
en.summary: Atlantic Airways orders two A320neo; aims for all‑neo fleet by 2030
body: On 27 October 2026 Atlantic Airways, the national carrier of the Faroe Islands, signed a firm order with Airbus for two A320neo aircraft, furthering its plan to transition to an all‑neo fleet.

Chairman Niels Mortensen said: “Our ambition is to operate an exclusively A320neo aircraft fleet in the near future, and this agreement marks a significant step towards achieving that goal,” with a target of completing the fleet renewal by 2030.
The airline currently operates two A320‑200s and two A320neos from Vágar Airport (FAE), the Faroe Islands’ sole airport. The new order brings its total A320neo commitments to four aircraft.
The purchase is part of a long‑term investment plan worth up to DKK 2 billion (approximately US$298 million). Deliveries of the two newly ordered jets are scheduled for the early next decade.

Airbus Executive Vice President of Commercial Aircraft Sales Benoît de Saint‑Exupéry welcomed the deal, noting that the additional A320neo aircraft will reinforce regional connectivity and support efficient links for Faroese communities.
